function.arguments: {"finding": "The initial raw difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) was positive (0.0785), suggesting email performed better. However, after stratifying by customer segment and computing the weighted average difference, the result is negative (-0.1246), indicating that paid search actually outperforms email when adjusted for customer segment. This reversal is due to confounding: email has a higher proportion of loyal and returning customers (who convert more), while paid search has more new customers (who convert less). The raw comparison was biased by this imbalance.", "implication": "The raw difference (0.0785) is not a valid estimate of the causal effect of channel on conversion. function.name: note_finding
